description: ET-3: Regression benchmark baseline — records p50 wall-time thresholds (seconds) for each bench_pipeline.py scenario. A run that exceeds threshold × 3 is flagged as a potential regression.
notes: Thresholds are conservative upper bounds (10-12 s) for a cold pipeline run on a laptop.
Tighten after collecting 5+ real baseline runs via: python benchmarks/bench_pipeline.py --json >> benchmarks/runs.jsonl
The test_bench_scenario pytest suite enforces a hard 30-s limit per scenario.
This file is read by tests/unit/test_benchmark_baseline.py to enforce soft regression alerts.
